# SUNKOOL

> SUNKOOL (Sunkool Solution) is an automotive window film and paint protection company based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. Since 2005, SUNKOOL has specialized in nano-ceramic heat-control glazing, solar-control films, and paint protection film (PPF) engineered for clarity, heat rejection, UV protection, and signal-friendly performance.

## Core Products

- [Window Film](https://www.sunkool.in/window-film): Nano-ceramic automotive window films (Legend, Elite, SK and Sunroof Special series, and the Signature range) for heat rejection, optical clarity, and UV protection.
- [PPF](https://www.sunkool.in/ppf): Aliphatic polyurethane paint protection film — self-healing, UV-resistant, and virtually invisible once installed.
- [Ultra Edge](https://www.sunkool.in/ultra-edge): Re-imagined by SUNKOOL. Specs shown as VLT / IR / UV / TSER (%). Ultra (sputtered silver): Ultra Max 75 / 96 / 99 / 60, Ultra 70 70 / 95 / 99 / 54, Ultra 50 50 / 99 / 99 / 75. Edge (titanium nitride): Edge Max 70 / 97 / 99 / 61, Edge 70 70 / 99 / 99 / 60, Edge 50 50 / 99 / 99 / 74. Prism (150+ nano multilayer PET): Prism 90 88 / 97 / 99 / 55, Prism 70 70 / 98 / 99 / 60, Prism 40 40 / 99 / 99 / 78. Sunroof Protection Film 70 / 95 / 99 / 60. Moonroof Protection Film 50 / 99 / 99 / 74.
- [Interior PPF](https://www.sunkool.in/interior-ppf): Interior protection film (195 micron, 99% UV protection, 3-year warranty coverage).

## Window Film Technology

Key solar-performance parameters used across SUNKOOL product specifications:

- **VLT (Visible Light Transmission, 380–700 nm):** Percentage of visible sunlight that passes through the glass. Higher VLT means more daylight and clearer outward vision.
- **UV-R / UV rejection (100–380 nm):** Percentage of ultraviolet radiation blocked. Important for skin comfort and reducing interior fading.
- **TSER (Total Solar Energy Rejected):** Combined share of solar energy (UV, visible, infrared, and related solar radiation) rejected by the film-and-glass system.
- **IRR / IR rejection (780–2500 nm):** Percentage of infrared energy blocked; primary driver of cabin heat reduction.
- **Optical clarity:** Films are designed to maintain clear vision and a premium appearance, including high-VLT grades suitable for windshield and daylight-priority applications.
- **Signal-safe construction:** Non-metallic / signal-friendly nano-ceramic and related constructions are engineered to avoid blocking GPS, mobile, and toll-tag signals on modern vehicles.

Published solar values are averaged from routine quality-control data and may vary by batch (±5%).

## Window Film Product Series

Source: current SUNKOOL product catalogue. Specs shown as VLT / TSER / IR / UV (%).

### Legend Series

SUNKOOL's most trusted shades.

- HD 70 (elegant blue tint) — 70 / 58 / 95 / 99
- SK 70 (subtle green tint) — 70 / 55 / 93 / 99

### Elite Series

Premium shades for a more refined, luxurious cabin.

- CH 70 (rich charcoal tint) — 70 / 55 / 93 / 99
- GY 70 (Royal Iron Grey tint) — 70 / 55 / 93 / 99

### SK Series

More shade choices (SK 70 is listed under Legend).

- SK 50 (olive grey tint; printed VLT 45%) — 45 / 71 / 95 / 99
- SK 35 (deeper grey tint) — 35 / 75 / 93 / 99

### Sunroof Special Series (36-month warranty)

For panoramic glass roofs and sunroofs.

- Moonroof Heat Control Glazing — 45 / 71 / 95 / 99 (applied from inside)
- Sunroof Protection Film — 70 / 60 / 92 / 99 (7.5 mil, applied from outside)

### Signature Series

SUNKOOL's premium range.

- Sapphire (Sapphire Blue tint, Titanium Nitride technology) — 70 / 60 / 99 / 99
- Emerald (nano-ceramic layer with a UV coating that filters UV-A, UV-B and high-energy violet light) — 70 / 55 / 92 / 99
- Onyx (greenish-black tint) — 50 / 74 / 99 / 99
- Graphite (graphite-toned neutral finish) — 35 / 80 / 99 / 99
- Topaz 70 (magnetron silver, TiN and Japanese nano-ceramic; dye-free multi-layer) — 70 / 61 / 97 / 99
- Topaz 50 — 50 / 75 / 99 / 99
- Diamond 90 (more than 150 nano-layers of PET; printed VLT 88%) — 88 / 55 / 97 / 99
- Diamond 70 — 70 / 60 / 98 / 99
- Diamond 40 — 40 / 78 / 99 / 99

### Signature Sunroof Glazing (60-month warranty)

- Signature Moonroof Heat Control Glazing — 50 / 74 / 99 / 99
- Signature Sunroof Protection Film — 70 / 60 / 95 / 99

Warranty covers adhesive failures, discoloration, cracking and more than 10% drop in UVR/IRR performance. Warranty durations are stated only for the two sunroof series (36 and 60 months).

## Solar-Control Solutions

SUNKOOL solar-control films address:

- Cabin heat rejection via infrared and total solar energy control
- UV protection for occupants and interior materials
- Glare reduction while preserving usable visible light
- Interior fade and sun-damage mitigation
- Overhead glass applications (sunroof and moonroof films)

Compare grades and solar metrics across the range on the [product comparison page](https://www.sunkool.in/compare).

## Paint Protection Film

- [PPF overview](https://www.sunkool.in/ppf): Clear aliphatic polyurethane film for stone-chip, scratch, and UV defence with a high-gloss finish.
- SUNKOOL HD07 — 7-mil TPU; VLT 99%; UV 99%; rapid self-healing top coat.
- SUNKOOL Signature Ultimate — 8-mil TPU; VLT 99%; UV 99%; gloss ≥140 GU; hydrophobic contact angle ≥110°; heat-restorative healing; Limited Lifetime Warranty (original owner; non-transferable per product terms).
- [Interior PPF](https://www.sunkool.in/interior-ppf): 195 micron interior film with 99% UV protection, scratch resistance, anti-yellow coating, stain resistance, and 3-year warranty coverage.

## Compliance and Regulations

- [Regulations](https://www.sunkool.in/regulations): Official SUNKOOL compliance information for Indian road use.
- Films are positioned as CMVR certified and aligned with IS 2553 visible light transmission standards.
- Side windows: IS 2553 (Part 2): 2019 (Revision 1) requires at least 50% VLT for driver and front-passenger glass.
- Always confirm current local limits with a certified installer; regulations content is informational, not legal advice.

## Warranty and Product Authenticity

- [Warranty](https://www.sunkool.in/warranty): Warranty overview, registration guidance, and authenticity resources.
- [SUNKOOL Warranty Portal](https://w.sunkool.in/): Check coverage by mobile, chassis, or vehicle number; register new installations via product/warranty QR flow.
- Typical coverage themes: bubbling, peeling, cracking, and discoloration; transferable vehicle warranties where stated; product-specific terms apply (for example, Signature PPF Limited Lifetime Warranty is original-owner only).
